capabilities: Splits pasted passages into verse-numbered propositions
Connects propositions with nested, labeled brackets
Flows Greek or Hebrew text in Text Flow and Sentence Flow canvases
Exports diagrams as PNG into the vault
Stores diagrams as plain JSON in portable .da files
disambiguation: Not an automated text analyzer; it is a manual editor for drawing bracket diagrams by hand.
extras: Companion free web app at sots1689.github.io/DA-Tool shares .da files with the plugin; styling is an approximation of the web tool and there is no automated test suite.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds a new file type — .da — that Obsidian opens in a dedicated diagramming view
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or store discourse-analysis bracket diagrams for biblical passages alongside notes.

relations.evidence: hand-ported, reasonable-fidelity approximation of the original web tool's look

summary: A vault-native diagramming tool that creates and edits discourse-analysis bracket diagrams for biblical passages, with Text Flow and Sentence Flow tabs.
